qk_vs_ov_reading: mlp2 (dCE=2.6209) and mlp3 (2.326) both dwarf every head and mlp1 (0.2913, matching the sampler filter value) for this copula-after-quote completion ('this "war" [is]') -- mid-stack MLPs, not the front table or attention, own most of the confidence. Top-OV head 7.8 (ov=0.0721, qk=0.023) is again PAYLOAD-regime -- same head as datapoint 1's top OV head, on a different target kind. Top-QK head 6.7 (qk=0.0338, ov=0.041, roughly matched) leans SELECTION -- its attention destination matters about as much as its payload.
category_story: Falsifiable class: mlp2's global scope, like mlp3's, is dominated by multi-token noun/name continuation and appositive completion (top hurt examples: 'an Orlando, Fla., [hospital]', 'Rowlett, Texas, [native]', 'not by [design]', 'a 2011 report ... a [nonpartisan]', 'leave well enough [alone]', 'travelling to [Orlando]', 'the government's ... capital, [Bog]ota', '"closed" prisons ... their U.S. [counterparts]'). Nothing in the top-30 involves a copula or sentence-continuation function -- it is the same broad subword/entity-table behavior seen for mlp0/mlp1/mlp3, not a copula-specific circuit.
local_global_match_note: MISMATCH: locally mlp2 (and mlp3) look like the mechanism for predicting the copula ' is' after a quoted noun phrase. Globally, mlp2's actual scope is generic noun/name subword completion with zero copula examples in its top-30 hurt positions. The local top-part signal at this one position is again not representative of what the part is FOR -- it is coincidental overlap with a broad completion table's activation, echoing datapoint 0's finding with a different mlp layer and a different target kind.
surprises: Head 7.8 reappears as the single top-OV, PAYLOAD-regime head across two datapoints with unrelated target kinds (' and' idiom-conjunction here vs. copula ' is'), and neither is a canonical known circuit -- worth a dedicated future datapoint set targeting head 7.8 directly rather than following it opportunistically. Also notable: for BOTH of the first two datapoints in this record set, the strongest single part overall is a non-mlp1 MLP layer (mlp3, then mlp2/mlp3 tied), contradicting the wave-1/wave-2-worker-B pattern where mlp1 always wins -- the well_predicted_nontable filter is doing its job of surfacing non-token-table datapoints, but it surfaces OTHER broad MLP layers rather than sharp attention circuits.
